sources.note: About LAMANG (Hidkala dialect), not Vemgo-Mabas. Fn. 1, pp. 112-113: 'Note that Lamang has a split prosodic system: syllable pitch is non-distinctive on nouns, but tone is lexically and grammatically distinctive on verbs, ideophones, and on grammatical morphemes including prepositions. Stress is marginally contrastive and occurs only in the subgrammar of nouns.' p. 113 lists 'Mabas (Vemgo)' among neighbouring languages and says Lamang, Mabas and Hdi form 'a language continuum'.
